ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ are four points in sequence on a straight line, $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of $AB$ and $CD$ respectively, and $MN=6\,\text{cm}$, $BC=3\,\text{cm}$. What is the length of $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $M$ and $N$ be the midpoints of $AB$ and $CD$ respectively.\\
Therefore, $AB = 2MB$ and $CD = 2CN$.\\
Since $MN = 6$ and $BC = 3$,\\
it follows that $MB + CN = MN - BC = 6 - 3 = 3$,\\
and therefore $AB + CD = 2MB + 2CN = 2(MB + CN) = 2 \times 3 = 6$,\\
hence $AD = AB + CD + BC = 6 + 3 = \boxed{9}$.
